steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Peel the potatoes, cut them into chunks and boil 15 minutes, until a fork slides in easily.
Dice the onion and the carrot small. Drain the cooked lentils.
Heat half the olive oil in a pan over medium heat, about 1 minute, until it shimmers. Cook the onion and carrot 6 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook 1 minute, until it darkens. Add the lentils, the green peas and the vegetable broth.
Simmer 8 minutes, until the sauce thickens. Spread in a 20 × 20 cm baking dish.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the remaining olive oil until smooth. Spread over the lentils and rough up the top with a fork.
Bake 20 minutes, until the top is golden at the ridges and the edges bubble.
Rest 10 minutes. Under 12 months, mash a portion with a fork. Keeps 4 days in the fridge; freezes 2 months.
